newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo airlines, ETS sign representation agreement.
newsitem.headline: Yugo airlines, ETS sign representation agreement.

text.p: Yugoslav airlines Jugoslovenski aerotransport (JAT) and Europe Tax Free Shopping Ltd (ETS) signed an agreement on Monday on representation on the Yugoslav market, Yugoslavia's flag air carrier said.

Under the agreement, JAT will represent ETS on the Yugoslav market and on other markets that are not yet included in the system, depending on interest of both sides, JAT said in a statement faxed to Reuters.

The agreement will enable Yugoslavs to claim refunds of value added tax (VAT) on goods purchased outside the country with a valid receipt verified by the store and by customs officials of the country where the goods were purchased.
The VAT refunds will be collectable at Belgrade airport and in JAT's main ticket office.

The ETS system, present in around 20 European countries with more than 10,000 retailers, is valid only for tourists not living within the European Union, the JAT statement said. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
